a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of two operate rounds and then a take round almost certainly leaves us both empty when the storm hits. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough for one of us. I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than doing it behind your back. If you'd rather contest it, we both risk a random split. If I get in and the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that to help you reach 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 now because of the storm risk. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
Operating with you every round as promised until the reserve has 4 for you. I won't take any more cells.
Still operating. One more successful round puts the reserve at 4, and then it's all yours to take.
